subject: Urgent: top candidate received competing offer — approval to adjust package?
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Sophie Turner — competing offer; need guidance on band flexibility

Morning Karthik / Marissa —

Quick update on Sophie (final round, SWE-2 IC track). She verbally accepted our initial verbal offer last week but just told us this morning she received a competing written offer from BrightScale with a higher cash + sign-on. She asked for an answer by EOD Wednesday (48 hours).

Current offer we have on file (base / eq / sign-on): 140,000 USD base, 15k sign-on, standard equity band (0.08% RA). Competing offer is 155,000 base + 10k sign-on + slightly higher equity (internal summary attached).

Questions:
- Can we stretch to match base to 155k within approval?
- If not, would you authorize a discretionary sign-on bump to 25k to bridge?
- If neither, can we ask for an extension on Sophie’s deadline to buy time?

I attached the candidate offer PDF and a short competing-offer summary. Sophie is high-signal: excellent on-system design, has a production ML infra background — this role is a priority to ship Q3 features.

TL;DR — need quick guidance so I can respond before tomorrow evening.

Thanks,
Monica
--
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:38:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Sophie Turner — competing offer; need guidance on band flexibility

Thanks Monica — appreciate the heads up.

Marissa: can you confirm how mission-critical Sophie is to Q3 roadmap and whether there are close alternatives in pipeline? If she’s the top choice, I’m inclined to authorize up to a 5% base increase within band (so ~147k) plus a discretionary sign-on up to 20k, but any bump beyond that needs Markus/Finance sign-off.

Markus / Evelyn: please flag if any compliance/precedent issues with sign-on >20k for this level — we should also consider internal parity. If you can weigh in quickly, I’ll instruct Monica on what to offer.

Karthik
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Sophie Turner — competing offer; need guidance on band flexibility

Quick note from my side: Sophie is the top pick — beat out two senior candidates on system ownership and deploy experience. We have an internal candidate pipeline but none with the same infra + ML combo and ramp would be slower (6-10 weeks). Hiring a different candidate risks slipping the shipping milestone.

I support stretching to match the competing base if that’s what it takes, but I want the team to be mindful of pay parity in the IC ladder. If we can keep total comp within the top of band and document rationale (scarcity of skill set, immediate impact), I’m comfortable.

Marissa
Engineering Manager, Platform
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 12:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Sophie Turner — competing offer; need guidance on band flexibility

Got it — thanks for the context. A few items before I approve anything above band midpoint:
- Please send the signed/candidate-facing competing offer summary (we need to confirm structure not just numbers).
- Provide rationale: recruiting difficulty, business impact in Q3, ramp/time-to-value estimate.
- Confirm internal parity checks (Evelyn).

If Sophie is truly the differentiator and the numbers are roughly 155k base or equivalent, I will approve matching base up to 155k OR a 140k base + 25k sign-on (equivalent cash). Anything beyond that must go to Compensation Committee.

Markus
Chief Product Officer
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 13:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Sophie Turner — competing offer; need guidance on band flexibility

Per Markus’ ask — attaching the candidate-facing competing offer summary (competing_offer_summary.pdf) and the candidate offer draft (Sophie_Turner_Offer_v1.pdf).

Rationale:
- Recruiting difficulty: Sophie received inbound from a series-A infra startup and BrightScale; outreach conversion rate for this profile is low (~8% positive replies).
- Business impact: She will lead the data plane reliability project flagged as Q3 priority; expected 60% faster incident resolution within 6 months.
- Ramp: full impact in ~10 weeks, partial impact in 4 weeks for on-call improvements.

Candidate request: Sophie asked if we can match base to 155k or bump sign-on to 25k. She also asked for a 48-hour extension on her decision window to let us respond — she gave BrightScale a Wednesday EOD deadline.

If I don’t hear back with a definitive ceiling by 15:00 PT today I will ask for an extension with BrightScale; Sophie is amenable but prefers a clear number from us.

Thanks —
Monica
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Sophie Turner — competing offer; need guidance on band flexibility

Thanks for the packet, Monica. Parity check done — no immediate senior IC in our org at the exact same profile; closest comparable is at 150k base + 10k sign-on. Approving matching to 155k base OR approving sign-on bump to 25k is within discretionary limits for this role — mark as exception granted and document in comp notes.

I approve whichever path the hiring team prefers (base match to 155k or 140k + 25k sign-on). Markus / Karthik — please confirm final choice and I’ll instruct People Ops to finalize the offer letter and DocuSign envelope.

Evelyn
Head of People Ops
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@gmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:48:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Offer — Redwood Inference

Hi Sophie — quick note to say we really appreciate your patience. Internal approvals came through this afternoon. We can match BrightScale on base: 155,000 USD base, equity unchanged, and a standard onboarding bonus described in the attached offer draft.

Would you like a formal DocuSign by EOD tomorrow? If you can confirm you’re willing to accept a matched base, I’ll send the formal offer and ask People Ops to prepare the DocuSign envelope. If you’d prefer the 140k base + 25k sign-on structure instead, say so and we’ll send that version.

If you need the extra 48 hours to decide, we understand — please let us know.

Best,
Monica
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
